subject: plotPXG or effectplot with boxplot or violin plots instead of mean +- SE

messages.author: 25e13e522040f0b9
messages.subject: plotPXG or effectplot with boxplot or violin plots instead of mean +- SE
parts:
I have phenotypes that are not normally distributed, so I'm looking for code to draw effectplots using violin or box plots instead of mean +/- SE and/or plotPXG's that have a violin plot or a boxplot next to the jitter.
Any help would be much appreciated.

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] plotPXG or effectplot with boxplot or violin plots instead of mean +- SE
parts:
The plotPXG function returns a data frame with the genotypes, phenotypes, and an indicator of whether the genotypes were inferred (1) or not (0). You could use this to create a box plot or whatever.

data(hyper)
z <- plotPXG(hyper, marker="D4Mit164")
boxplot(z[,2] ~ z[,1])

if(!require(UsingR)) {
install.packages("UsingR")
library(UsingR)
}
violinplot(z[,2] ~ z[,1])

karl
